programme.title: Exploring the "National Quintessence" - Peking Opera
programme.desc: In this episode, we invite viewers to delve into Peking Opera, celebrated as the "Oriental Opera." The program visits Hu Wenge, the third-generation inheritor of the Mei School; Fu Boyang, grand disciple of Meng Guanglu and dean of Jixiang Grand Theatre; and Guo Xiaojing, a top Douyin influencer specializing in Peking Opera. Join host Yegor as we explore Peking Opera's history, immerse in its traditional artistic atmosphere, witness behind-the-scenes preparations and makeup processes, and discover the passion of today's youth for this art form. We'll also visit the Beijing Guoyi Children's Peking Opera Troupe to see how Peking Opera shapes the lives of young students.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as "Quanzhou Nanyin," is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of "a living fossil in the history of Chinese music." The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou's people.

The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou's people.

The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou's people.

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there’s the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there’s plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou’s tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an “Emporium of the World”!

programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy. From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty, there's so much to explore in Xi'an. So, get your camera and your stomach ready for CGTN's Foodwise in Xi'an!

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-2 Chinese Wrestling
programme.desc: In Episode 2, Chinese Wrestling, host Kleber joins a public training session led by Wang Tongqing, a master preserving the imperial Shanpu Ying wrestling tradition. Swept up in the group’s lively atmosphere, he gets a first-hand feel for the master’s skill. Kleber then invites his Italian friend Paolo to train systematically, uncovering how Chinese wrestling principles connect with other martial arts, from Tai Chi to Wing Chun. Through Master Wang’s story of bringing a formerly imperial martial art into the public sphere, mentoring the next generation, and hoping to take it onto the international stage, the episode shows wrestling as more than a test of strength. It is a cultural bridge between history and the present.

programme.desc: Tianran He explores Lhasa’s bustling Barkhor Street, where pilgrims, locals, and visitors alike circle its ancient lanes. Across the city, he meets high school students dancing for Douyin — China’s version of TikTok, blending street dance with traditional Tibetan moves. Finally, Tianran travels to the birthplace of Tibetan incense, where waterwheels still power this thousand-year-old craft.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.1
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He rounds off his travels through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He journeys into the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon - one of the largest and deepest canyons on Earth, and along the way, tries to catch a glimpse of Mount Namcha Barwa, the easternmost peak of the Himalayas. Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

programme.title: My Little Cricket Fighter
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore a time-honored form of entertainment in China that has existed for thousands of years – cricket fighting. Music, Chinese chess, calligraphy and painting, and raising flowers, birds, fish and insects are known as the Eight Traditional Pastimes of the Chinese people. Raising insects may be the last on the list, but it is a pastime unique to China. Though these small creatures are tiny, the culture surrounding them has been nurtured by the Chinese people over thousands of years, embodying the unique cultural psychology, folk customs and aesthetic values of the Chinese nation.

programme.title: Into Guilin's landscapes: A new way to experience rural China
programme.desc: Guilin in south China's Guangxi region has long been celebrated for its breathtaking karst landscapes. Today, more and more travelers are discovering the region in a different way. Instead of simply admiring the scenery, they immerse themselves in it through cycling, hiking, bamboo rafting or via ferrata, experiencing the countryside from a new perspective. Supported by convenient transport links and a thriving outdoor recreation industry, Yangshuo County in Guilin is emerging as a global magnet where nature, culture and local life converge. Join CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipina singer Eliza Arce as they explore Yangshuo through a variety of outdoor adventures.

programme.title: Into Guilin's landscapes: A new way to experience rural China
programme.desc: Guilin in south China's Guangxi region has long been celebrated for its breathtaking karst landscapes. Today, more and more travelers are discovering the region in a different way. Instead of simply admiring the scenery, they immerse themselves in it through cycling, hiking, bamboo rafting or via ferrata, experiencing the countryside from a new perspective. Supported by convenient transport links and a thriving outdoor recreation industry, Yangshuo County in Guilin is emerging as a global magnet where nature, culture and local life converge. Join CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipina singer Eliza Arce as they explore Yangshuo through a variety of outdoor adventures.

programme.title: Ad Break

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there’s the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there’s plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou’s tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an “Emporium of the World”!

programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy. From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty, there's so much to explore in Xi'an. So, get your camera and your stomach ready for CGTN's Foodwise in Xi'an!

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-2 Chinese Wrestling
programme.desc: In Episode 2, Chinese Wrestling, host Kleber joins a public training session led by Wang Tongqing, a master preserving the imperial Shanpu Ying wrestling tradition. Swept up in the group’s lively atmosphere, he gets a first-hand feel for the master’s skill. Kleber then invites his Italian friend Paolo to train systematically, uncovering how Chinese wrestling principles connect with other martial arts, from Tai Chi to Wing Chun. Through Master Wang’s story of bringing a formerly imperial martial art into the public sphere, mentoring the next generation, and hoping to take it onto the international stage, the episode shows wrestling as more than a test of strength. It is a cultural bridge between history and the present.

Swept up in the group’s lively atmosphere, he gets a first-hand feel for the master’s skill. Kleber then invites his Italian friend Paolo to train systematically, uncovering how Chinese wrestling principles connect with other martial arts, from Tai Chi to Wing Chun. Through Master Wang’s story of bringing a formerly imperial martial art into the public sphere, mentoring the next generation, and hoping to take it onto the international stage, the episode shows wrestling as more than a test of strength. It is a cultural bridge between history and the present.

programme.title: My Little Cricket Fighter
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore a time-honored form of entertainment in China that has existed for thousands of years – cricket fighting. Music, Chinese chess, calligraphy and painting, and raising flowers, birds, fish and insects are known as the Eight Traditional Pastimes of the Chinese people. Raising insects may be the last on the list, but it is a pastime unique to China. Though these small creatures are tiny, the culture surrounding them has been nurtured by the Chinese people over thousands of years, embodying the unique cultural psychology, folk customs and aesthetic values of the Chinese nation.

programme.title: Into Guilin's landscapes: A new way to experience rural China
programme.desc: Guilin in south China's Guangxi region has long been celebrated for its breathtaking karst landscapes. Today, more and more travelers are discovering the region in a different way. Instead of simply admiring the scenery, they immerse themselves in it through cycling, hiking, bamboo rafting or via ferrata, experiencing the countryside from a new perspective. Supported by convenient transport links and a thriving outdoor recreation industry, Yangshuo County in Guilin is emerging as a global magnet where nature, culture and local life converge. Join CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipina singer Eliza Arce as they explore Yangshuo through a variety of outdoor adventures.

programme.title: Foodwise: Datong
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Angela Fu are in historic Datong. Located in northern China's Shanxi Province, some 1500 years ago Datong was the capital of the Northern Wei Dynasty, which saw nomads unite northern China and Buddhism spread throughout the country. At the renowned Yungang Grottoes where giant Buddhas were carved out of cliffs, our hosts discover Datong's multicultural past and sample the emperor's favorite cake. They seek out the remains of a Jesuit church beneath the Great Wall of China, and find in the local cuisine elements that echo the past, and modern-day recipes for thousand-year old dishes.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-3 Shaolin Style
programme.desc: Episode 3, Shaolin, explores how this thousand-year-old temple has evolved into a unique “kung fu platform” that draws enthusiasts from around the world. Host Kleber immerses himself in Shaolin’s integrated way of life, where Chan (Zen) practice and martial training go hand in hand, and turns the camera toward foreign practitioners pursuing their kung fu dreams both inside and beyond the temple gates. Along the way, he meets international disciples living and training at Shaolin, as well as students learning the rare art of Shaolin Xinyiba under Master Hu Zhengsheng, a former Shaolin monk. At martial arts schools near Songshan Mountain, Kleber also encounters overseas competitors training hard for the arena. Together, their stories reveal Shaolin kung fu’s enduring pull, one that crosses cultures and borders while uniting practitioners through tradition, discipline, and self-mastery.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.3
programme.desc: Join Tianran He on a high-speed train to Shigatse, gateway to the Himalayas and home to Mount Qomolangma, the world’s highest peak. He then visits an agricultural park where tropical crops thrive against the odds of the alpine plateau, before discovering pulu — a traditional Tibetan textile now earning global acclaim.

programme.title: Foodwise: Datong
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Angela Fu are in historic Datong. Located in northern China's Shanxi Province, some 1500 years ago Datong was the capital of the Northern Wei Dynasty, which saw nomads unite northern China and Buddhism spread throughout the country. At the renowned Yungang Grottoes where giant Buddhas were carved out of cliffs, our hosts discover Datong's multicultural past and sample the emperor's favorite cake. They seek out the remains of a Jesuit church beneath the Great Wall of China, and find in the local cuisine elements that echo the past, and modern-day recipes for thousand-year old dishes.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-3 Shaolin Style
programme.desc: Episode 3, Shaolin, explores how this thousand-year-old temple has evolved into a unique “kung fu platform” that draws enthusiasts from around the world. Host Kleber immerses himself in Shaolin’s integrated way of life, where Chan (Zen) practice and martial training go hand in hand, and turns the camera toward foreign practitioners pursuing their kung fu dreams both inside and beyond the temple gates. Along the way, he meets international disciples living and training at Shaolin, as well as students learning the rare art of Shaolin Xinyiba under Master Hu Zhengsheng, a former Shaolin monk. At martial arts schools near Songshan Mountain, Kleber also encounters overseas competitors training hard for the arena. Together, their stories reveal Shaolin kung fu’s enduring pull, one that crosses cultures and borders while uniting practitioners through tradition, discipline, and self-mastery.

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

programme.title: KONA MAI 2026
programme.desc: Rehatkan minda anda pada penghujung hari bersama Shah, Faruk & Mimie dalam segmen KONA MAI. Segmen ini membawakan pilihan lagu santai, pengisian rohani, serta seleksi lagu-lagu kesukaan anda di Tapaw Lagu @ Kafe Muzik. Sebelum melelapkan mata, nikmati alunan lagu-lagu melankolik terkini, bahasa Melayu, Inggeris, dan Indonesia untuk menemani malam anda dengan penuh kedamaian.

programme.title: GENG PAGI MUTIARA
programme.desc: Mulakan Pagi anda dengan penuh bersemangat bersama Chombi dan Bambam!\\n Segmen ini menyajikan gabungan lengkap untuk memulakan hari anda dengan positif—daripada pengisian rohani menerusi bacaan Al-Quran, nasyid, dan Santai Nurani, hinggalah kepada berita sahih, laporan trafik semasa, tajuk-tajuk akhbar utama, serta topik pagi yang santai dan menghiburkan. Jangan lupa layan lagu-lagu permintaan anda dalam slot Layan Pagi sebelum melangkah ke tengah hari!

programme.title: FOKUS MUTIARA
programme.desc: Sambil buat kerja atau berehat, penyampai kami Azie, Elly , Mimie & Fazrinah sedia menemani dengan pelbagai maklumat berguna dan hiburan menarik. Dapatkan petua serta tips gaya hidup serta pelbagai perkongsian harian yang terkini. Nikmati juga kelainan irama Bollywood menerusi Syoknya Hindi & mengimbau memori menerusi Everlasting Memory dengan lagu retro Inggeris terbaik serta laporan berita Warta Mutiara secara langsung bagi memastikan anda sentiasa peka dengan isu semasa.

programme.title: PETANG KREW
programme.desc: Petang anda pastinya tidak hambar bersama gandingan serasi Amin , Que , Mimie dan Fazrinah! Sambil melayan perjalanan pulang dari kerja, dapatkan pengisian Mutiara Ilmu, tips keusahawanan dalam Biz On Air, serta bincangkan pelbagai Isu hangat dan menarik menerusi Ralet Cheq. Tak lengkap petang anda tanpa menguji minda dalam peraduan Teka Tiara Nyanyi bersama kemaskini trafik dan berita terkini.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: This hilarious compilation features dancing dogs, talking dogs, some of the world's cleverest canines - and priceless puppy fails, all caught on camera for our serious amusement. Plus we catch up with the stars of some of the web's most popular dog videos

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The Japanese animated film My Neighbor Totoro, which is popular all over the world is the childhood memory of many. Totoro's classic furry body, round eyes and cute expression are very endearing. In South America, there is a kind of chinchilla that looks very similar to Totoro in the film. I heard that Taiwan now allows legal imports of these animals for breeding! Today, let’s follow the Totoro zoo owner Molly and fall in love with the soft and cute charm of this animation star!

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc:
Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".
But they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Thornton Heath, South London, Inspector Nick Wheelhouse is called out to see three adult mastiffs and nine puppies who are all drastically underweight. Will Gaza, the mother and the skinniest of the dogs, be able to regain the weight she so desperately needs.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa. They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!! They are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive. They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

programme.title: The Travelling Foodie
programme.desc: An English-language food magazine programme exploring Malaysia’s diverse culinary landscape, featuring a variety of local dishes, flavours, food traditions and culinary experiences from across the country.

programme.title: DUNIA MELAYU - LEGASI MARITIM MELAYU
programme.desc: Legasi Maritim Melayu is a documentary segment under Dunia Melayu that explores the rich maritime heritage of the Malay civilisation. The programme highlights the ingenuity and achievements of the Malay people in navigation, shipbuilding, seafaring knowledge, and maritime trade, showcasing their historical role as skilled sailors and influential players in regional and international maritime networks.

programme.title: Mukjizat Dan Sains
programme.desc: A programme exploring the scientific and technological dimensions of selected Quranic verses, highlighting their relevance to modern scientific discoveries and knowledge. Hosted by Associate Professor Dato’ Dr. Mohd Izhar Ariff, the programme offers an insightful perspective on the relationship between the Quran, science and technology.

programme.title: Ilmuan Islamiah
programme.desc: A programme exploring the development of various fields of knowledge pioneered and advanced by prominent Islamic scholars and thinkers. Each episode features two influential figures — a historical scholar and a contemporary thinker — highlighting their contributions, ideas and lasting impact on their respective fields.

programme.title: Iqra'
programme.desc: A Quran learning programme focused on talaqqi and guided Quran reading, helping viewers of all ages learn to read the Quran correctly with proper tajwid and pronunciation.

programme.title: Nawaitu
programme.desc: A programme exploring the importance of intention (niat) as the foundation of every action, through real-life stories and experiences within society. It highlights how sincere intentions can transform good deeds into acts of worship, while misguided intentions may lead to unintended consequences, guided by teachings from the Quran and Hadith.

programme.title: Kata Sifu
programme.desc: A mentorship programme featuring accomplished experts from selected fields as Sifus (mentors) who share their knowledge, skills and experience with their mentees. Hosted by Wanns Ahmad, the programme offers an engaging platform for learning, guidance and personal growth.

programme.title: Kota Warisan Alam
programme.desc: A travelogue exploring Malaysia’s heritage cities, showcasing their unique history, culture, natural attractions and interesting places for visitors to discover. Each episode takes viewers on a journey through the country’s heritage destinations and highlights experiences worth exploring.

programme.title: Warisan Kita
programme.desc: An engaging programme for general audiences that showcases Malaysia’s rich heritage, highlighting the country’s diverse cultural traditions, customs, arts and historical legacy.

programme.title: Etnik Kita
programme.desc: A travelogue following host Alif Hadi as he journeys across Malaysia to discover the lives, cultures and traditions of the country’s minority ethnic communities, offering viewers a closer look at their unique heritage and way of life.

programme.title: Lagu Negaraku
programme.desc: Negaraku is the national anthem of Malaysia, symbolising the nation’s sovereignty, unity, and patriotism.

programme.title: GLOBAL - ON THE TABLE
programme.desc: In this latest episode of On The Table, the discussion explores how Artificial Intelligence (AI) is reshaping the future of work and transforming modern workplaces. The programme looks at the changing nature of jobs, evolving workplace skills, and how organisations and employees can adapt to an increasingly AI-driven working environment.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: This episode (76), present various cultural traditions, agricultural shifts, and economic impacts around the globe, starting with the deep cultural importance of traditional Afghan flatbread (naan) as a staple of hospitality and daily life, alongside France's globally renowned cheese industry, which blends ancestral production methods with modern certification systems to protect its vital economic and heritage status. It also showcases Malaysia's tourism appeal through recurring promotional segments emphasizing its rich heritage and natural beauty. On the economic front, the video examines how the FIFA World Cup drives global commerce, particularly through Chinese manufacturers rapidly scaling the production of Lionel Messi plush toys to monetize high fan engagement. Additionally, it covers the strategic shift in northwest Syria's Idlib province toward low-water, high-value saffron cultivation to revive the war-torn economy, and concludes with the major resurgence of indigenous, nutrient-rich foods in Zimbabwe, where cities like Bulawayo are seeing an increase in traditional restaurants helping to promote healthier lifestyles and preserve national identity.

programme.title: GLOBAL PERSPECTIVE : MALAYSIA'S REGIONAL DIPLOMATIC EFFORTS
programme.desc: Under the leadership of Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim, Malaysia has prioritized an \"ASEAN First\" foreign policy centered on deepening diplomatic ties, honest communication, and mutual respect with its neighbors to bolster economic and regional stability. This cooperative framework is materialized through major high-value cross-border projects with Singapore, such as the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JSSEZ) and the Rapid Transit System (RTS) Link, which aim to enhance digital economy integrations, secure sustainable skilled employment, and improve labor mobility. Furthermore, during its 2025 ASEAN Chairmanship focused on inclusivity and sustainability, Malaysia expanded the regional architecture by admitting Timor-Leste, charting the long-term \"ASEAN 2045\" strategic vision, and demonstrating its diplomatic efficacy by facilitating a swift 24-hour ceasefire between Cambodia and Thailand. Ultimately, these parallel security and geoeconomic strategies—such as releasing a historical communique regarding Palestine/Gaza and maintaining stable dialogue over the South China Sea—reinforce ASEAN centrality while driving Malaysia forward to attract major global investments and position Southeast Asia as a resilient, high-value global economic hub.

programme.title: ASEAN - RASA ASEAN
programme.desc: Rasa Asean, is a culinary travel program involving the tastes of food from Asean countries with Chef Fikri and Chef Naim who will also produce and serve the stories behind the traditional food.

programme.title: Asean Women Entrepreneurship
programme.desc: Episode 1 features the stories and entrepreneurial journeys of three women entrepreneurs from ASEAN — Christy Ng (Malaysia), Boutsaya Viengviseth (Laos), and Nikha Akhsaniyati Kholisoh (Indonesia) — as they build their businesses, overcome challenges, and unlock new opportunities. The programme highlights their entrepreneurial spirit, creativity, and the vital role of women in driving economic growth across the ASEAN region.

programme.title: ASEAN - JEJAK HALAL ASEAN
programme.desc: A travelogue exploring the diverse cultures, traditions and everyday lives of Muslim communities across ASEAN. This episode of Jejak Halal ASEAN takes viewers on a journey through Satun, Thailand, discovering its rich Islamic heritage, halal culture and unique local way of life.

programme.title: MUSLIM WORLD - KALAM WAHYU (TILAWAH)
programme.desc: Kalam Wahyu is a special segment under Muslim World featuring a compilation of Quran recitations from the 2024 International Quran Recitation and Memorisation Assembly. The programme showcases beautiful and melodic recitations by participants from Bosnia Herzegovina, Kazakhstan, Canada and India reflecting the diversity and unity of the Muslim world through the art of Quranic recitation.

programme.title: MUSLIM WORLD - SYAHADAH (UZBEKISTAN)
programme.desc: The Syahadah documentary series produced by RTM frequently features travel episodes highlighting the unique aspects and Islamic heritage of Uzbekistan. Key highlights previously broadcasted include stories of master carvers, Malaysia-Uzbekistan cultural ties, and journeys through historic locations such as Tashkent and Fergana.

programme.title: MUSLIM WORLD - KALAM WAHYU (HAFAZAN)
programme.desc: Kalam Wahyu is a special segment under Muslim World featuring a compilation of Quran memorisation recitations from the 2024 International Quran Recitation and Memorisation Assembly. The programme highlights participants from Ireland, Liberia, Mauritania and Somalia as they demonstrate their mastery and memorisation of the Holy Quran through specially tested recitation sessions.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us

programme.title: GLOBAL PERSPECTIVE : MALAYSIA'S REGIONAL DIPLOMATIC EFFORTS
programme.desc: Under the leadership of Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim, Malaysia has prioritized an \\\"ASEAN First\\\" foreign policy centered on deepening diplomatic ties, honest communication, and mutual respect with its neighbors to bolster economic and regional stability. This cooperative framework is materialized through major high-value cross-border projects with Singapore, such as the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JSSEZ) and the Rapid Transit System (RTS) Link, which aim to enhance digital economy integrations, secure sustainable skilled employment, and improve labor mobility. Furthermore, during its 2025 ASEAN Chairmanship focused on inclusivity and sustainability, Malaysia expanded the regional architecture by admitting Timor-Leste, charting the long-term \\\"ASEAN 2045\\\" strategic vision, and demonstrating its diplomatic efficacy by facilitating a swift 24-hour ceasefire between Cambodia and Thailand. programme.title: Signal 1203
programme.desc: Signal 1203 – The Midnight Experience on REDfm\\\\n\\\\nGet ready for a brand-new late-night adventure with Signal 1203, your ultimate companion from 12am to 3am on REDfm for Variety! This isn’t just another radio show – it’s a full-on experience. Dive into fresh, youth-focused content, spine-chilling horror stories that will keep you on the edge of your seat, and trending topics that matter to you. We have Technology, Horror, chillout music, movie reviews, crime drama and so much more!\\\\n\\\\nAnd of course, what’s a night show without killer music? We’ve got the best tracks to keep your vibe alive through the early hours. Whether you’re up late studying, driving, or just chilling, Signal 1203 is your signal for something different.\\\\n\\\\nStay tuned. Stay awake. Stay connected. Only on REDfm – for variety.\\\\n\\\\n

programme.title: Morning Music 音乐早点
programme.desc: 《音乐早点》你最贴心的早间声音伴侣。我们不聊冗长的资讯，只精选最舒缓、最动听的旋律，配合清新的晨间絮语，为你卸去昨夜的疲惫，装满清晨的能量。无论你正行走在通勤的路上，还是在享用一份惬意的早餐，让《音乐早点》用惬意的乐音，陪你开启美好而有温度的一天。

programme.title: Midday Mix Part 1
programme.desc: Playing you the best hits from the past to current hits, along with news, interviews and interesting topics.

programme.title: Tech Me
programme.desc: A tech focused program with the latest updates on Tech news, Gaming and Gadgets. Every Monday at 12:15pm

programme.title: MIDDAY MIX PART 2
programme.desc: Our variety program for the afternoon. 1pm - 4pm. Great music, fun DJs and total entertainment for 3 hours!!

programme.title: 音乐下午茶Teabreak
programme.desc: 星期一道星期六，下午4-5点，忙碌的午后，需要适时的暂停。《音乐下午茶》 是一档专为午后时光打造的治愈系音乐随笔节目。

programme.title: 下班开麦啦
programme.desc: 叮！下班铃声响起，属于你自己的时间正式开始。《下班开麦啦》是你在晚高峰通勤路上最懂你的“解压陪伴站”。告别繁琐的工作汇报和烦人的KPI，这里只有轻松搞笑的职场吐槽、热辣接地气的社会热议，以及最治愈的音乐与故事。无论你正挤在拥挤的地铁里，还是堵在回家的车流中，戴上耳机，和我们一起开麦畅聊，把一天的疲惫一扫而空！

programme.title: 听歌好时光
programme.desc: 忙碌的生活里，你有多久没有好好听完一首歌了？这里是《听歌好时光》，你的私享音乐会客厅。我们不设复杂的门槛，没有沉重的叙事，只挑选最惬意、最动听的旋律，为你揉碎日常的喧嚣。沏一杯清茶，或是斟一杯咖啡，在这个专属的空间里，让我们用好歌慢下来，静静享受属于你的好时光。

programme.title: 孤芳自赏
programme.desc: 在快节奏与商业大片的喧喧嚷嚷之外，总有一些电影选择安静地立于角落，散发着独一无二的光芒。这里是《孤芳自赏》，一处专属于高冷影迷与独立电影的声音（视觉）放映厅。\n\n我们带你穿透繁复的光影，解读那些被低估的冷门佳作、艺术大师的独行之作，以及镜头深处最隐秘的人性角落。不追热门，不作媚俗之语。今夜，让我们在独立的光影世界里，孤芳自赏。

programme.title: 歌里寻他千百回
programme.desc: 人海茫茫，我们总在别人的歌声里，寻找着自己的影子。这里是《歌里寻他千百回》，一档用旋律解构心事、用歌词安放灵魂的声音空间。每一首经典的背后，都藏着一段未完的故事；每一段动人的旋律，都是一次久别重逢。夜色渐深，请戴上耳机，跟随我们的声音，在漫漫歌海中，寻觅那个曾让你怦然心动、或是泪流满面的“他”。

programme.title: Sinister - The Gates of Hell
programme.desc: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hell's Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: A Woman Scorned
programme.desc: Jas's peaceful countryside getaway with her sister Laura is shattered when a group of drifters attacks them. After Laura is brutally killed, Jas discovers her lifeless body at their rented cabin. Consumed by grief and fury, she vows to hunt down the gang and take vengeance on her sister's murderer.

programme.title: Red Rain

programme.title: Sinister - Girlfriend
programme.desc: Bullied by his coworkers, the lonely Ah Zhen turns to the internet in search of his ideal girl. However, when Mina, the woman of his dreams, suddenly enters his life, a series of unexpected events begins to unfold.

programme.title: Room For Rent
programme.desc: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

programme.title: Sinister - The Virtual Game

At Mei Qi's gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qi's husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: A Woman Scorned
programme.desc: Jas's peaceful countryside getaway with her sister Laura is shattered when a group of drifters attacks them. After Laura is brutally killed, Jas discovers her lifeless body at their rented cabin. Consumed by grief and fury, she vows to hunt down the gang and take vengeance on her sister's murderer.

programme.title: Red Rain
programme.desc: Based on true events, a young scientist who specialises in the study of aliens and extraterrestrials sets out to uncover the mystery behind a series of strange occurrences in Kerala.

programme.title: Ten Minutes to Midnight
programme.desc: Radio host Amy is bitten by a mysterious bat, but she returns to the station to host that night’s late-night show. Instead, she is set up and fired by her ruthless boss, then replaced by a newcomer. As a violent storm traps everyone in the station and her mysterious wound worsens, Amy gradually loses control and unleashes a bloody massacre.

programme.title: Detective Dee's Seven Deadly Sin
programme.desc: Detective Dee becomes embroiled in a series of murders that shake the Tang Empire. The killer invokes the "Seven Deadly Sins" to justify a twisted sense of justice. In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

programme.title: Mulu Nakru
programme.desc: After moving into a house with her boyfriend, Gun, architect May learns of her stepmother’s mysterious death. When May takes in her stepsister Noon, the girl begins showing signs of possession, while May suffers disturbing visions and insomnia. As dark secrets emerge, spiritual masters uncover an ancient black-magic curse hidden within the house.

programme.title: Model Family
programme.desc: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect. However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

programme.title: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2
programme.desc: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents' dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

programme.desc: After their young daughter’s mysterious disappearance, Drew and Helen retreat to a secluded woodland cottage for therapy.
